sectionsUsed: Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap, release table: Java SE 25 is a long-term support (LTS) release, the most recent LTS.
OpenJDK JDK 25 project page, Status and Schedule: JDK 25 reached General Availability; the page lists its features.
JDK 25 Installation Guide, Overview of JDK Installation: the JDK is installed per operating system (macOS, Linux, Windows); the guide links the per-platform steps.
Eclipse Temurin releases page: JDK 25 - LTS builds are offered for macOS, Linux and Windows, with a JDK/JRE package-type choice.
Adoptium Installation overview: Temurin installs through package managers or installers per platform; Windows Latest LTS via winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.25.JDK.
Adoptium macOS PKG installer packages, GUI installation: download the .pkg, open it, Continue, accept the license, Install; Temurin installs under /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/.
Adoptium Linux (RPM/DEB/APK) installer packages: add the Adoptium apt or RPM repository, then sudo apt install temurin-25-jdk or sudo dnf install temurin-25-jdk.
Adoptium Windows MSI installer packages, GUI installation: open the .msi, accept the license; on Custom Setup the PATH feature is on by default and the JAVA_HOME feature can be selected; Install.

JDK 25 Installation Guide for macOS, Determining the Default JDK Version and FAQ: several JDKs can be installed; java -version shows the default; set JAVA_HOME with /usr/libexec/java_home -v 25 in the shell startup script.

Dev.java, Getting Started with Java, sections on the JDK and the JRE: the JDK holds javac and java; the JRE is a subset that only ran applications and is no longer distributed by OpenJDK or Oracle; set up PATH so the JDK tools are found.

Apache Maven, Installing Apache Maven, Prerequisites and Binary distribution: a JDK is needed, found via JAVA_HOME or the java executable on PATH; extract the archive (unzip or tar xzvf) and add its bin directory to PATH; confirm with mvn -v in a new shell, which also prints the Java version Maven uses. JAVA_HOME priority over PATH also read from the bin/mvn launcher script of Apache Maven 3.9.16.
Apache Maven, Download page: current releases and their minimum JDK requirement; binary archives for all platforms.
IntelliJ IDEA help, Install IntelliJ IDEA: installation on macOS, Linux and Windows.
IntelliJ IDEA help, Maven, open an existing Maven project: open the pom.xml file and choose Open as Project so the IDE imports the Maven project.
IntelliJ IDEA help, SDKs, Change project SDK: File | Project Structure | Project, select the SDK; the IDE keeps its own list of JDKs, separate from the terminal PATH.
Dev.java, Building a Java application in IntelliJ IDEA: creating or opening a project and choosing its JDK.
Dev.java, Building a Java application in Visual Studio Code: the documented alternative IDE.
